title: Bi-Lipschitz bounds for a C¹ immersion on a compact set on which it is injective
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P be C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ), and let K ⊆ ℝ^d be compact such that ψ is injective on K and Dψ(y) = fderiv ℝ ψ y is injective for every y ∈ K. Then there are real numbers m > 0 and Λ such that m|a − b| ≤ |ψ(a) − ψ(b)| ≤ Λ|a − b| for all a, b ∈ K (Euclidean norms on ℝ^d = Euclid d and ℝ^P = Euclid P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (K : Set (Euclid d)), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → IsCompact K → InjOn ψ K → (∀ y ∈ K, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ∃ m Λ : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ a ∈ K, ∀ b ∈ K, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖ψ a - ψ b‖ ∧ ‖ψ a - ψ b‖ ≤ Λ * ‖a - b‖
